description: Moving Traffic Enforcement - Enforcement Points - Validation photos . is a series of datasets listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. Leicester City Council operates a bus lane enforcement scheme to improve public transport reliability, journey times and to encourage sustainable travel. Coverage: Leicester. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under City and Governance. Its keywords are Bus Lane, enforcement. The portal shows 27 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
